messages.name: Welcome / day 0
messages.subject: Welcome to Halfday. Tea time starts here.
messages.preheader: Meet your next iced tea favorite.
messages.heading: Make time for tea.
paragraphs: Welcome to Halfday. We're happy you found us.
We make prebiotic iced tea in flavors you'll want to keep in the fridge. Take a look around, find your favorite, and follow the Amazon link on its page when you're ready to stock up.
We'll be in your inbox with flavor news and more from Halfday. For now, let's find your first sip.

messages.name: Flavor discovery / day 2 at noon
messages.subject: What's your kind of tea break?
messages.preheader: A familiar favorite or something new? Start with the flavors.
messages.heading: Your fridge. Your favorites.
paragraphs: Some days call for a familiar flavor. Others call for trying something new.
Explore Halfday's iced teas and variety packs to find your next fridge favorite. Each product page has the details and a link to buy on Amazon.
Prefer picking up a can while you're out? Our store locator can help you find Halfday nearby.

messages.name: Brand story / day 5 at noon
messages.subject: A little more about Halfday
messages.preheader: Meet the people behind your tea break.
messages.heading: Good tea. A story to share.
paragraphs: You've met the tea. Now meet the people behind it.
Our story is a good place to get to know Halfday, our founders, and how it all started.
Thanks for making a little room for us in your day.
